zh-CN.title: 扩展开发示例
zh-CN.description: 演示中间件、任务生命周期、模型观察器、服务、HTTP 路由，以及向当前会话写入文件的模型工具。

usage.title: 安装到开发环境
usage.description: 参考包内文档安装示例，配置并重启 Gateway。它用于演示扩展开发接口。

usage.title: 运行任务并检查统计
usage.description: 执行包含工具调用的任务，再通过示例统计 API 查看调用次数、结果类型与耗时。

usage.title: 让助手保存一条笔记
usage.description: 请助手把一段内容保存为笔记。save_note 工具会把 Markdown 文件写入当前会话的输出目录，文件会出现在产物面板和文件视图中。

en-US.title: Extension development example
en-US.description: Explore middleware, task lifecycle, model observers, services, HTTP routes, and a model tool that writes a file into its conversation.

usage.title: Install in a development environment
usage.description: Follow the package guide to install, configure and restart Gateway. This package demonstrates extension development contracts.

usage.title: Run a task and inspect statistics
usage.description: Run a task that uses tools, then inspect call counts, outcome types and durations through the example statistics API.

usage.title: Ask the assistant to save a note
usage.description: Ask for a note to be saved. The save_note tool writes a Markdown file into the conversation's outputs, where it opens in the artifact panel and is listed in the Files view.
